definitions.route: An addressable top-level prototype view selected by one stable hash path.
definitions.screen: The single visible route canvas. Template v1 maps one screen to one route.
definitions.state: A non-addressable presentation variant inside a screen; it does not increase the route or screen count.

routes.label: Start
routes.purpose: Introduce the prototype flow and its limitation warning.

routes.label: Input
routes.purpose: Capture one local-only choice without persistence or network access.

routes.label: Complete
routes.purpose: Show the non-production end state and restart action.

states.interaction: Announce progress with role=status; never hide navigation indefinitely.
Explain the missing local fixture and offer one recovery action.
Use role=alert, plain-language local error text, and a retry action.
Render the current screen content and its bounded primary/secondary actions.

breakpoints.navigation: Horizontally scrollable labeled progress list; one-column content and full-width actions.
Labeled progress list above a centered content card; actions remain keyboard ordered.

tokens.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no interaction depends on animation.

interactions.primary: Continue to the next route in primaryFlowOrder.
interactions.secondary: Return to the previous route without remote persistence.
interactions.retry: Move ERROR directly to deterministic local SUCCESS without network access.
interactions.restore: Move EMPTY directly to deterministic local SUCCESS without network access.
interactions.restart: Clear in-memory selection and return to /start.

requirements: Semantic landmarks and one level-one heading per screen.
Programmatic labels and plain-language status/error announcements.
Color is not the only carrier of status.

prototypeWarning.text: Prototype only - not a live production system.
prototypeWarning.placement: Persistent banner rendered on every route above the primary content.
